hooks.command: b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$b" ] && exit 0; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Current git branch: %s"}}' "$b"

p=$(cat); n=$(printf '%s' "$p" | grep -oE 'AB#[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/AB#//'); [ -z "$n" ] && exit 0; cur=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); case "$cur" in *"$n"*) exit 0;; esac; m=$(git branch --format='%(refname:short)' 2>/dev/null | grep -F -- "$n" | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ *$//'); [ -z "$m" ] && exit 0; printf '{"systemMessage":"WRONG BRANCH: AB#%s has branch(es) [%s] but you are on %s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"BRANCH CHECK FAILED. This prompt references AB#%s. These local branches already exist for that story: %s. The current branch is %s. Do NOT edit, write or create any file until you switch to the story branch or the user explicitly confirms working elsewhere. Tell the user about this mismatch before doing anything else."}}' "$n" "$m" "$cur" "$n" "$m" "$cur"
